title: The stalk of the etale units sheaf is additively equivalent to separable-closure units with the natural Galois action.
statement:
The stalk of the etale units sheaf is additively equivalent to separable-closure units with the natural Galois action. The precise hypotheses and action-on-germs formula are recorded by the following Lean signature: theorem exists_etale_units_stalk_galois_equiv (K : Type u) [Field K] :
    let Ks := SeparableClosure K
    let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∃ c : (p.sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj S.gmSheaf ≃+ Field.galoisUnitsTopRep K,
      ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
        (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
          τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
        (X : S.Etale) (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
        (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
        (z : S.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op X)),
        c (p.toPresheafFiber X x' S.gmSheaf.obj z) =
          (Field.galoisUnitsTopRep K).ρ g (c (p.toPresheafFiber X x S.gmSheaf.obj z))

proof.text: Obtain the explicitly constructed evaluation homomorphism from [lem-sc-etale-units-stalk-evaluation]. Apply [lem-sc-etale-units-stalk-evaluation-bijective] and AddEquiv.ofBijective to obtain the additive equivalence. Its underlying function is the same evaluation homomorphism.

For the action formula, reduce equality through Additive.toMul, Units.ext and the injective separable-closure embedding. The evaluation formula gives the left-hand side. Apply hτ to the value of the original germ to rewrite the right-hand side as τ of its evaluation. Substitute the lift relation hx, use Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, and apply Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality to τ. This is exactly the desired equality on values, and the injective reductions prove the original equality.
